test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B are running in the same direction at the speeds of 9km/h and 3km/h, respectively, on a circular track of length 27 km. They will meet again after:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of A = 9 km/h

Speed of B = 3 km/h

Length of circular track = 27 km

**Formula used:**

Relative speed when running in the same direction = Speed of A - Speed of B

Time taken to meet again = Length of the track / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 9 km/h - 3 km/h

⇒ Relative speed = 6 km/h

Time taken to meet again = 27 km / 6 km/h

⇒ Time taken = 4.5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
